Define in MatchRewards.ts:
export interface MatchRewardInput{rank:number;playerCount:number;holesPlayed:number;holesCompleted:number;totalStrokes:number;coursePar:number;holesInOne:number;birdies:number;durationSeconds:number}
export interface MatchReward{xp:number;breakdown:{completion:number;win:number;podium:number;holesInOne:number;birdies:number}}
export function calculateMatchReward(input:MatchRewardInput):MatchReward
export function applyMatchStatistics(stats:PlayerStatistics,input:MatchRewardInput):PlayerStatistics
XP rules: completion 100; win (rank===1) +50; podium (rank 2 or 3 and playerCount>=4) +25; +20 per hole in one; +10 per birdie. Win and podium are mutually exclusive. xp is the sum, floored at 0 and rounded to an integer.
applyMatchStatistics returns a NEW object: increments matchesPlayed, increments matchesWon when rank===1, adds holesPlayed, holesCompleted, totalStrokes and holesInOne, adds Math.max(0,Math.round(durationSeconds)) to totalPlayTimeSeconds, and sets bestRoundStrokes to the smaller of the old value and totalStrokes only when holesCompleted === holesPlayed and holesPlayed > 0. Treat non finite numbers as 0. Never mutate the input stats.
CONSTRAINTS: no DOM, no Three.js, no Rapier; do not edit src/gameplay/index.ts or any existing gameplay file.
ACCEPTANCE: at least 6 tests: winner baseline xp is 150, podium only applies with 4+ players, hole in one and birdie bonuses, input stats not mutated, bestRoundStrokes set only on a full round, bestRoundStrokes keeps the lower value. Run `npx vitest run src/gameplay/rewards.test.ts` and `npx tsc -b --pretty false`; both must pass.

export type BotTurnPhase='idle'|'thinking'|'aiming'|'shooting'|'done';

Defaults: thinkSeconds 0.9, aimSeconds 0.8, shootSeconds 0.35. timingForProfile scales think time by planningDepth (+0.25s per depth above 1) and by personality ('careful' x1.25, 'bold' x0.8, 'trickster' x1.1, otherwise x1), then adds random()*0.3 jitter when a RandomSource is given.
update(dt) advances an internal clock and returns the current status: thinking uses statusText `${botName} is thinking` with showAimLine false; aiming uses `${botName} is aiming` with showAimLine true; shooting sets fireShot true on the FIRST update entering that phase only, after which the phase becomes done with empty statusText. progress is 0..1 inside the current phase. begin() restarts the clock; reset() returns to idle.
